question: If the mode of a data exceeds its mean by 10.8, then the mode exceeds the median by _____. (Use empirical formula to find the answer.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Empirical formula: Mode = 3Median − 2Mean

Given: Mode − Mean = 10.8

⇒ Mode − Median = (2/3)(Mode − Mean)

= (2/3) × 10.8 = 7.2

**∴ Answer = 7.2**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Mode − Mean = 10.8

**Formula used:**

Mode = 3Median − 2Mean

**Calculation:**

⇒ Mode = 3Median − 2Mean

⇒ Mode − Mean = 3Median − 3Mean

⇒ 10.8 = 3(Median − Mean)

⇒ Median − Mean = 3.6

⇒ Mode − Median = (Mode − Mean) − (Median − Mean)

⇒ = 10.8 − 3.6

⇒ = 7.2

**∴ The correct answer is 7.2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Empirical Relation

Mode ≈ 3Median − 2Mean

Difference Concept

Relate differences using algebra

Shortcut

Mode − Median = (2/3)(Mode − Mean)
